name: Import Conflict Resolutions
description: Add conflict resolution import to Create Compare Project, matching existing resolutions by normalized DOI or article ID plus title and failing creation on duplicate or conflicting matches.

userStories.title: Build conflict resolution import matching helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a focused server helper for conflict resolution import matching so duplicate detection, DOI matching, and skip/error behavior can be tested independently from the route.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.ts` with reusable normalization and import-planning helpers.
Normalize DOI by trimming, lowercasing, and removing common DOI URL or `doi:` prefixes.
Normalize external article ID by trimming and lowercasing, and normalize title by trimming, lowercasing, and collapsing internal whitespace.
Prefer DOI matching when a usable DOI exists on both source and target articles; otherwise match by external article ID plus normalized title.
Detect duplicate source DOI keys, duplicate target DOI keys, duplicate source ID-title keys, and duplicate target ID-title keys as hard errors.
Detect conflicting source resolution values that map to the same target article as a hard error.
Detect resolution values that are not valid for the target compare project's summary options as hard errors.
Return import candidates and skip counts for source rows with no usable key, no target match, or target articles that are not conflict-resolution eligible.
Add adjacent tests covering DOI match, ID-title match, DOI preference, duplicate errors, conflicting values, invalid values, no-key skip, no-target skip, and not-conflicting skip.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Expose eligible conflict resolution import sources
userStories.description: As a user creating a compare project, I want to see compare projects that have saved conflict resolutions so I can choose which ones to import from.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `GET /api/comparison-projects/conflict-resolution-import-sources` to `src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.ts`.
Return only non-archived compare projects with `allow_conflict_resolution = TRUE` and at least one row in `app.comparison_project_conflict_resolution`.
Return `id`, `name`, `description`, `createdAt`, `humanJudgmentMode`, and `resolutionCount` for each source.
Order eligible sources predictably, with newest or most relevant projects first.
Add a typed client service function and response type in `src/services/comparisonProjectsService.ts`.
Update route surface inventory if this repo requires new API routes to be listed there.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Import resolutions during compare project creation
userStories.description: As a user, I want selected conflict resolutions imported only when validation is unambiguous so the new compare project is not created with duplicate or conflicting imported state.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend `CreateComparisonProjectFromProjectInput` with `conflictResolutionImportSourceComparisonProjectIds?: string[]`.
Extend `/api/comparison-projects/from-project` request validation to accept selected import source compare project IDs.
Return `400` when import source IDs are provided but Summary mode or Allow conflict resolution is not enabled.
Validate selected import source compare projects exist, are not archived, and contain conflict resolutions before creating the new compare project.
Query import work from selected conflict-resolution rows first, not from all articles.
Use constrained target article candidate queries from the small DOI and ID-title key sets, restricted to the new compare project scope.
Run duplicate, ambiguous, invalid-value, and conflicting-value validation before any permanent compare project row survives.
Create the compare project and imported `app.comparison_project_conflict_resolution` rows in one DuckDB transaction.
Roll back the transaction so no new compare project exists if import validation fails after creation starts.
Return the created project plus import summary counts for scanned, matched, imported, and skipped rows.
Add route tests for valid import, duplicate validation failure leaving no compare project row, and rejection when conflict resolution is disabled.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add create-page import conflict resolutions UI
userStories.description: As a user creating a compare project, I want a bottom-page section for selecting conflict resolution import sources so I can reuse prior decisions safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an `Import Conflict Resolutions` section near the bottom of `src/app/routes/+compare-judgments/+create-from-project.tsx`, after Additional Projects to Compare With and before submit buttons.
Hide or disable the section with explanatory text unless a primary project is selected and Summary mode plus Allow conflict resolution are enabled.
Load eligible import sources through TanStack Query and the new service function.
Show loading, error, and empty states for the import source list.
Render a checkbox list of eligible compare projects with names, human judgment mode, and resolution counts.
Include warning copy that duplicate or conflicting matches stop creation and no compare project is created.
Submit selected `conflictResolutionImportSourceComparisonProjectIds` with the create-from-project request.
Show server validation errors on the form and keep the user on the create page when duplicates, ambiguous matches, or invalid imported values are reported.
Clear selected import sources when conflict resolution becomes unavailable.
Preserve the existing browser create flow when no import sources are selected.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
Web flow is verified with `bun run dev:server` and `bun run dev:app` by creating a compare project with and without selected import sources.
Desktop impact is considered and `bun run desktop:build` is run if UI or route wiring changes beyond server-only helpers.
